fichas.title: Pig Keeping: Housing and Welfare Requirements
fichas.summary: The page presents theoretical shed layouts for breeding pigs, area requirements under the EU Eco Directive, and animal-welfare provisions for pig housing. Requirements address group housing, dry lying areas, flooring and slat dimensions, daylight, activity materials, and access to water.
uses: Housing breeding sows, boars, piglets, and fattening pigs
